_comment: F-16 training curricula. Popup text is fixed doctrine; geometry and threats are seeded at build time from difficulty profiles.

sead_viper.briefing_situation: A scripted SEAD training sortie over range airspace. Follow the route; instructions appear at each phase gate.
sead_viper.briefing_objective: Complete each phase as briefed. Suppress all assigned SAM sites along the route.

messages.intro:
HTS / HARM TRAINING

Loadout: 4x AGM-88, AIM-120C on wingtips only, HTS on station 10.
AG master mode. Sensor select toggles HTS (6) vs TGP.

Fly the route. Briefings will appear as you reach each phase.
messages.phase1_hts:
PHASE 1 — HTS SEARCH

Master mode AG. Press 6 for HTS (not HARM yet).
DTK on the left DED: set range scale with DEP/RTN if the picture is empty.
Fly toward the route — emitters appear as symbols when their radars are active.
Cursor over a symbol: read the emitter line on the DED.
messages.phase2_handoff:
PHASE 2 — HANDOFF & SHACK

With HTS cursor on a live emitter:
  • TMS FWD (short) = handoff to HARM seeker
  • Switch to HARM (7), select HAS or POS as briefed
SHACK on the DED means the HARM has a valid seeker track — you may fire.
No SHACK = do not launch. Break turn, reposition, hand off again.
messages.site_complete_rearm:
SITE COMPLETE — REARMING

SAM site is down. Your HARM load is being replenished.
Continue to the next training area on the route.
messages.phase3_second_site:
PHASE 3 — NEXT SITE

Same flow: HTS (6) to build the picture, handoff, HARM (7), confirm SHACK, shoot.
Multiple emitters? Cursor the track radar first, then mop up launchers.
messages.training_complete:
TRAINING COMPLETE

All assigned sites suppressed. You now have the full HTS-to-HARM chain:
HTS picture → handoff → SHACK → launch.
RTB when ready.

jdam_viper.briefing_situation: A scripted JDAM training sortie. Destroy supply targets along the route; point-defense threats guard each objective.
jdam_viper.briefing_objective: Complete each phase as briefed. Destroy all assigned targets with GBU-38 JDAM.

messages.intro:
JDAM TRAINING

Loadout: 4x GBU-38, AIM-120C on wingtips, Litening TGP on station 10.
Master mode AG. Sensor select toggles TGP (5).

Fly the route. Briefings appear at each phase gate.
messages.phase1_route:
PHASE 1 — INGRESS

Fly the route at briefed altitude.
TGP (5): verify the target area as you approach.
Check MAN page: confirm JDAM program and desired TOT if using CNTL.
messages.phase2_designate:
PHASE 2 — DESIGNATE & RELEASE

TGP on the target:
  • Cursor / slew crosshairs onto the aimpoint
  • TMS FWD (short) = designate (DMPI)
  • Select JDAM on SMS, confirm CNTL or VIS mode as briefed
  • Pickle when IN RNG and criteria met

Expect point defense near the target — plan egress before you pickle.
messages.target_complete:
TARGET COMPLETE

Target destroyed. Continue to the next objective on the route.
messages.phase3_next_target:
PHASE 3 — NEXT TARGET

Same flow: TGP designate → JDAM release → egress.
Re-acquire the next aimpoint before you commit.
messages.training_complete:
TRAINING COMPLETE

All assigned targets destroyed.
You have the full JDAM chain: TGP designate → weapon release → egress.
RTB when ready.
